model_annotation: This plot illustrates the loss values over a range of iterations for different models. The x-axis represents the number of iterations, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 140,000, and tick labels spaced at regular intervals of 20,000. The y-axis represents the loss, with a linear scale, ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, and tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.1. There are six lines in the plot: the purple line represents "Vanilla" with no marker; the blue line represents "StrmLLM (n=64)" with no marker; the orange line represents "SepLLM (n=64)" with no marker; the green line represents "SepLLM (n=64, H)" with no marker; the red line represents "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" with no marker; and the dark blue line represents "SepLLM (n=128)" with no marker. The purple line starts at approximately 3.35 and decreases to around 2.45; the blue line starts at approximately 3.35 and decreases to around 2.45; the orange line starts at approximately 3.25 and decreases to around 2.45; the green line starts at approximately 3.25 and decreases to around 2.45; the red line starts at approximately 3.25 and decreases to around 2.45; and the dark blue line starts at approximately 3.2 and decreases to around 2.45, with all lines exhibiting a sharp decline in the initial 20,000 iterations, followed by a steady decrease.
